MAESTRO_DEBIT.codeApplicability: 012 and 013 require separate network/program confirmation; generic debit codes are not Maestro permissions

rules.statement: A Track-2-capable credit device should send Track 2 by default.
rules.condition: Initial credit magnetic-stripe transaction; Track 2 supported and readable.
rules.quote: The default track that is sent to the host should be Track 2 if the device supports Track 2.

rules.statement: When Track 2 cannot be read, send unaltered Track 1 before attempting manual entry.
rules.condition: Initial credit transaction; Track 2 unreadable and Track 1 readable.
rules.quote: If the device cannot read Track 2, then the device should send unaltered Track 1 on the initial transaction, before attempting manual entry.

rules.statement: After three failed credit-card stripe reads, prompt for manual Account Number and MMYY expiry entry.
rules.condition: Three failed magnetic-stripe reads; device workflow, not a host-decline oracle.
rules.quote: If unable to read the magnetic strip after three attempts, the device should prompt for manual entry of the Account Number and Expiration Date (Format: MMYY).

rules.statement: Manual credit entry must be indicated by an asterisk before the Account Number on the receipt.
rules.condition: Credit manual entry; receipt observation only, not journal or account truncation.
rules.quote: If manual entry is used, this fact is indicated on the receipt and journal by an asterisk (*) before the Account Number.

rules.statement: Manual credit entry must be indicated by an asterisk before the Account Number in the journal.
rules.condition: Credit manual entry; journal observation only.
rules.quote: If manual entry is used, this fact is indicated on the receipt and journal by an asterisk (*) before the Account Number.

rules.statement: A debit transaction must not allow manual entry.
rules.condition: Debit processing under Section 10.2, not Signature Debit processing as Credit.
rules.quote: Manual entry is not allowed on a debit card transaction.

rules.statement: After three failed debit-card stripe reads the transaction must end.
rules.condition: Three failed debit magnetic-stripe reads; transaction-state observation only.
rules.quote: If unable to read the magnetic strip after three attempts, a message should be displayed to the clerk and the transaction ended.

rules.statement: A TOR for a debit Completion transaction is unsupported.
rules.condition: Debit Completion timeout; not an original debit Purchase timeout.
rules.quote: Time-out Reversal for debit Completion transaction is not supported.

rules.statement: A credit partial-approval reversal amount must equal the original approved amount.
rules.condition: Partially approved credit original; full reversal of that approved amount, not a partial reversal.
rules.quote: The amount in a Reversal (Void) request must be the amount approved in the original transaction response when a transaction has been partially approved.

rules.statement: A debit partial-approval reversal amount must equal the original approved amount.
rules.condition: Partially approved debit original.
rules.quote: The amount in a Reversal (Void) request must be the amount approved in the original transaction response when a transaction has been partially approved.

rules.statement: A debit partial-approval TOR amount must equal the original approved amount.
rules.condition: TOR of a partially approved original debit transaction, not debit Completion.
rules.quote: The amount in a TOR request must be the amount approved in the original transaction response when a transaction has been partially approved.

rules.statement: Credit Authorization Only Reversal must preserve the original Approval Number.
rules.condition: Authorization Only Reversal of an original with Element 5 present.
rules.quote: Element No. 5 (Approval Number)—present in the original transaction—must be present and identical in the Authorization Only Reversal transaction.

rules.statement: Credit Authorization Only Reversal must use Transaction Type S.
rules.condition: Credit Authorization Only Reversal; not Purchase Reversal.
rules.quote: Element No. 78 (Prompt Code) must contain a Transaction Type code “S” to indicate cancellation.

rules.statement: A lifecycle follow-up must preserve the initial authorization Sequence Number.
rules.condition: Associated subsequent transaction, not a new independent split-tender purchase.
rules.quote: Sequence Number must persist in all the subsequent transactions that are associated with the initial authorization request.

rules.statement: Element 86 has a six-digit representation.
rules.condition: Sequence Number representation only; uniqueness and lifecycle identity are separate predicates.
rules.quote: Number: 86 Name: Sequence Number Character Type: N Maximum Length: 6 bytes Representation: Fixed length of six digits

rules.statement: Previously authorized voids/completions whose original PAN Entry Mode was 90 must use 02.
rules.condition: Previously authorized Void or Completion; original PAN Entry Mode 90.
rules.quote: They will use a PAN Entry Mode code 02 when referencing an original Purchase or Authorization transaction in which a PAN Entry Mode code 90 was used.

rules.statement: EMV Element 188 is three bytes.
rules.condition: EMV Card Sequence Number representation only; tag agreement and allowed values are separate.
rules.quote: Number: 188 Name: EMV Card Sequence Number Character Type: AN Maximum Length: 3 bytes Representation: Fixed length of three bytes, right-aligned and padded with zeroes

rules.statement: When EMV Tag 5F34 is absent, Element 188 contains three spaces.
rules.condition: EMV chip card does not provide tag 5F34.
rules.quote: If EMV Tag 5F34 is not provided by the card, send three spaces

rules.statement: Credit financial Prompt Codes use financial card type 020.
rules.condition: Generic Credit code mapping only; Mastercard identity requires separate program/network evidence.
rules.quote: 020 Credit Credit

rules.statement: Mastercard Fleet financial Prompt Codes use card type 080.
rules.condition: Mastercard Fleet financial transaction, not generic credit.
rules.quote: 080 MasterCard® fleet Fleet

rules.statement: Debit checking financial Prompt Codes use card type 011.
rules.condition: Confirmed debit checking account; generic mapping is not Maestro network permission.
rules.quote: 011 Debit checking Debit

rules.statement: Debit savings financial Prompt Codes use card type 012.
rules.condition: Savings mapping only; Maestro/network applicability is unresolved.
rules.quote: 012 Debit saving Debit

rules.statement: Debit ACH financial Prompt Codes use card type 013.
rules.condition: ACH mapping only; Maestro/network applicability is unresolved.
rules.quote: 013 Debit ACH Debit

rules.statement: A Financial Transaction Request must include Segment 100.
rules.condition: Standard Financial Transaction Request; logical segment presence only.
rules.quote: All Financial Transaction Request messages contain this data segment in Data Section No. 2, Field No. 3.

rules.statement: An EMV Financial Transaction Request must include Segment 130.
rules.condition: EMV Financial Transaction Request; logical companion presence only, not EMV contents.
rules.quote: 130 EMV Request Data Segment 999 9 R Contains the EMV data required for all EMV card transactions.

rules.statement: Element 63 must equal the number of serialized financial input segments.
rules.condition: Standard Financial Transaction Request; fixture supplies a synthetic serialized segment list, not producer JSON object count.
rules.quote: The value of this field, call it N, indicates that the transaction will have the 100 segment + N-1 of the input segments listed in Chapter 12.

blockedDecisions.question: Review legacy BR release equivalence, applicability, atomicity and overlap with the overlay before approving a complete denominator.
Which general credit rules also apply to Mastercard Fleet? Do not infer this only from network ownership.
Confirm Maestro savings/ACH applicability before requiring physical variants 012/013.
Provide independent routing, settlement and program evidence for Signature Debit and US Maestro Common AID contexts.
Resolve general-credit versus FSA/HRA partial-approval TOR wording before creating a universal amount oracle.
Confirm the supported Mail/Phone Authorization completion message/code before approving the flow.
Supply client cards, dynamic bindings, EMV cryptograms and response captures; logical predicate fixtures are not wire or host fixtures.
Classify prepaid/commercial products independently instead of inferring them from generic card codes.
